name: context-tide
description: Band above the prompt that shows the context window as a tide: a fill bar, the trend per turn, a sparkline of recent turns and how many turns are left before compaction.

compact_at.title: Compaction threshold
compact_at.description: Context fill, in percent, that counts as full: the bar turns red there and the turns-left estimate counts down to it.

history_turns.title: Turns in the sparkline
history_turns.description: How many recent turns the sparkline shows.
